## Selected work

- [Vidhi Parmar](https://www.vidhiparmar.me): AI visual artist, Mumbai. Design and build. A hire-me portfolio that moves like her films: a showreel hero, selected AI ad films, a four-step process, services and FAQs.
- [Sashe by Prachi](https://sashebyprachi.vercel.app): Fashion label, Mumbai. Design and build. A digital flagship for a bespoke fashion label: an editorial hero, signature looks, studio forms and the founder's story. Built mobile-first to the founder's pixel-level bar.
- [U Scale](https://uscale.in): My own studio, Mumbai. Brand, design, build and SEO. The site for my practice: every price published, free tools for local businesses, a blog and pages written to be found by Google and AI search.
- [TIS Admissions 2026–27](https://tis-school-admissions-2026.vercel.app): School, Kandivali West. Concept, design and build. A concept admissions experience for an ICSE school: programmes, campus life and an enquiry flow with no friction.
- [Antrah Wellness](https://antrah-wellness.vercel.app): Wellness gathering, Mumbai. Design and build. A launch site for a two-day wellness gathering: five paths to wellbeing in one calm place.
- [Roar Arena](https://roararenaindia.vercel.app): Sports, India. Design and build. A live match centre and fan community for India's watch-party culture.
- [GrowCred](https://greencred.vercel.app): Climate tech. Product build. A climate-tech platform where people plant trees, upload proof and earn TreeCoin.
- [BrandGen](https://www.getbrandgen.com): AI SaaS. Website and social media. The website and social media for an AI tool that turns one brand reference into on-brand marketing visuals.
- [My Country Mobile](https://mycountrymobile.com): Telecom, in-house role. UI/UX and web development. Interface design and web development for an AI-first cloud phone and contact-centre platform, plus WordPress pages and marketing graphics.
- [Callmama](https://www.callmama.com): Telecom, in-house role. UI/UX and web development. Product design and the web experience for an international calling brand, built while I was at My Country Mobile.

## Services

- Design: research, flows and wireframes, then real screens in Figma, with a design system the team can keep using.
- Build: the approved design coded to match, responsive, fast and accessible, in React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS or WordPress, with forms and analytics.
- Grow (through U Scale): Google Business Profile, SEO, social media and ads, with a monthly report.

## Questions

### Who is Mehul Karotra?
Mehul Karotra is a UI/UX designer and developer in Mumbai. He designs websites and product interfaces in Figma and builds them in code himself. He works as a UI/UX developer at Apex36 Technology Services and runs U Scale, his own practice for websites, SEO, social media and ads.

### What does Mehul design and build?
Marketing websites, portfolios, landing pages and product interfaces. The work covers research, flows and wireframes, final screens and design systems in Figma, then responsive, fast and accessible front-end code in React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS or WordPress, with forms and analytics wired in.

### How much does a website cost?
Through U Scale, prices are published: a landing page is ₹25,000, a 3–4 page business site ₹55,000, a 5–10 page site with a blog ₹85,000, and e-commerce starts at ₹95,000. The full price list is at uscale.in/pricing.

### How long does a website take?
Most websites launch in 4 to 8 weeks, depending on the number of pages and how quickly content is ready.

### Does Mehul do the work himself?
Yes. Mehul designs and codes every project personally, so what you approve in Figma is exactly what goes live. There are no hand-offs to other designers or developers.

### How do I start a project?
Send a WhatsApp message to +91 79773 60142 or email mehulbitmaster@gmail.com with what you are building. Mehul usually replies the same day.
